$about: The colours of the site, by role. build/tokens.mjs writes them into src/styles/base/tokens.gen.css as --c-<name> and checks every pair in `contrast` (WCAG 2 ratio). Styles never write a colour literally (build/rules.mjs).

One ink, cool grey #2d2f33, in alpha steps on light grounds (as the Figma variables «cool gray/NN»), white in alpha steps on dark ones. Grounds: white page, cloud #f6f6f6 for cards and tiles, cool grey for the business section, black for photos and the hero. Lavender is the brand's one colour: eyebrows and the active state, never a surface. Descriptor dots have their own small palette by flavour family (descriptors).

fades.$about: Fades from clear to a colour, eased (as github.com/enisbu/tw-easing-gradients): a straight two-stop gradient shows a hard edge where it ends; these follow an S-curve in 16 stops, so the photo melts into the ground. build/tokens.mjs writes each as --fade-<name>, the stops of a linear-gradient().

contrast.$about: text colour / ground / least ratio: 4.5 for text, 3 for large text (24px and up) and the parts of controls. ink-60 is only for large text (the inactive catalog tabs) and parts of controls (the hollow weight dot); ink-50 and lighter only for lines and decoration. Secondary text is ink-70.

descriptors.$about: The dot before a descriptor: one colour per flavour family; the first family whose word appears in the descriptor wins. The dot is decoration (the word is the information), so it needs 3:1 only against its pill.
